name: branding-tulip-symbol-skincare-jar-and-torn-tape-label
title: Geometric tulip mark with droplets on an amber jar and taped condensed slogan
whatItIs: A white slide with a black tulip built from a folded bloom, two leaf halves and three droplets. Below: an amber glass jar with a black lid bearing the mark on warm stone, and a black sheet with translucent tape strips carrying the tall slogan 'CLEAN · GENTLE · EFFECTIVE' and an outline wordmark.
whatItMeans: Clean, soft and crafted; the symmetrical flower suggests care and growth.
techniques: Build a flower from a few geometric shapes plus droplets.
Print on amber glass to make a warm product photo.
Overlay translucent tape strips with tall condensed slogan text.
Stay black and white on natural surfaces.

vocabulary.definition: Small teardrop shapes added around a symbol.
Translucent tape strips used as a graphic layer.
A tagline in tall narrow letters.
